title: smime test fixtures: Oracle cross-check comment in SIG_RSA_DER_HEX is authoritative
description: smime_tests.rs: the SHA-256 value of 'Test message content' is hardcoded as a comment in SIG_RSA_DER_HEX. This is a genuine independent oracle check embedded in the fixture comment. A contributor might remove it as 'just a comment' — it should be defended as the only human-verifiable link between the hex blob and the plaintext. Keep it.
